summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 results press release dated November 5, 2026, disclosing an agreement to sell a further 20% of La Trobe Financial. No price per share, implied value or premium was stated. Management noted roughly $1.4 billion of year-to-date asset-sale proceeds and distributions and that twice invested capital has been returned on La Trobe while retaining over half its original ownership. The release also references agreed acquisition of Reliance Worldwide and completed purchases of World Freight Company and Gregg Distributors. Watch for formal La Trobe sale confirmation, buyer identity and redeployment timing.
